_about: A very short description shown before the ORPHAcode of a form in a card's Orphanet classification list, before any synonym. 'from' says what it condenses: Orphanet's own definition (Orphadata en_product1.xml, CC BY 4.0, read 2026-10-25), or, for a group Orphanet does not define, the forms it files under it.

973.short: fingers 2 to 5 short or missing, one hand

2130.short: one forearm or lower-leg bone absent or very short

93334.short: well-formed extra little finger or toe

93335.short: small, undeveloped extra little finger or toe

93336.short: thumb with three bones, sometimes duplicated

93337.short: index-like finger in place of the thumb

93405.short: all fingers joined, often six digits
